item.description: Discover what's new and happening in Albuquerque in 2026.

item.title: Visit Albuquerque Releases 2026 Official Visitors Guide Highlighting Route 66 Centennial | Visit Albuquerque
item.description: Visit Albuquerque has released the 2026 Official Albuquerque Visitors Guide, a full-color, 92-page guide designed to inspire travel to Albuquerque and help visitors and locals explore all that the city has to offer.

item.title: Visit Albuquerque Releases 2026 Valentine’s Day Gift Guide | Visit Albuquerque
item.description: Just in time for Valentine’s Day, Visit Albuquerque, the city’s official destination marketing organization (DMO), has released its 2026 Valentine’s Day Gift Guide, showcasing locally made, one-of-a-kind gift ideas and encouraging shoppers to support Albuquerque’s small businesses.

item.title: Albuquerque Set to Welcome the 2026 USATF Masters Indoor Championships | Visit Albuquerque
item.description: Albuquerque will host top masters track and field competitors from across the country as part of the 2026 USATF Masters Indoor Championships, taking place Feb. 19-22 at the Albuquerque Convention Center. The four-day national championship event is expected to draw nearly 2,500 attendees and generate $1.3 million in estimated direct visitor spending.
